run_command: docker compose up -d (production single container, image ghcr.io/mealie-recipes/mealie, e.g. port 9925:9000). Local dev: `task setup` then `task py` (backend :9000, SQLite default) + `task ui` (Nuxt dev :3000); optional Postgres via `task dev:services` + `task py:postgres`.
host: http://localhost:9000 (backend API + production SPA static files, single origin). In local dev the Nuxt frontend runs separately on http://localhost:3000 and calls the backend on :9000.
api_style: REST + OpenAPI (FastAPI). API base path /api (APIRouter(prefix='/api')). Swagger UI at /docs, ReDoc at /redoc, raw spec at default /openapi.json.
spa: yes — Vue 3 + Nuxt 3 built as a static SPA (ssr:false, `nuxt generate --spa`); in production the FastAPI backend serves the prebuilt SPA bundle from the same origin.
auth: required for essentially all non-public routes (only public 'explore' group endpoints and /docs are open). OAuth2 password grant: POST /api/auth/token (form username/password) -> bearer JWT; JWT also accepted via httpOnly cookie mealie.access_token. OIDC/SSO and long-lived API tokens also supported.
